alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm was transient, tied to rolling deployment (deployments_in_flight=1) that briefly touched desired/running task count. New task <TASK_7e0753c5> started healthy at 05:23:18 alongside existing task <TASK_d148af97>; both show continuous healthy heartbeats through 05:24:50 with tasks_running == tasks_desired, tasks_pending=0, deployments_failed=0, and normal CPU/mem. No errors, restarts, or unhealthy logs seen. Likely self-resolved false/transient alarm from normal deploy cycling, not real degradation.
